entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. My name is Charlie. I see you're calling about a recent order. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It works fine. I just changed my mind.
I understand. Can you tell me a little more about what's not working for you? Sometimes there are features people miss that can really enhance the experience.
No. It was just an impulse buy. I don't use it, and I want my money back.
Alright, no problem at all. Let me just pull up our policy. One moment... Okay, I see your VeloBand was delivered eight days ago.
And you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can go ahead and cannot offer a refund for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label.
Fine. So I don't have to bother with some resale marketplace? Great.

That's correct. We can handle the return directly. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Whatever. Just make sure the email actually shows up.
It's been sent. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
